item: packages/opencode-plugin/lib/gate.js currently only gates write tools

title: OpenCode cooperative stop parity gap
summary: OpenCode currently runs `tool.execute.before` only through the write gate path for write/edit/patch tools. The adapter contract requires a blocking cooperative stop check (`GET /should-stop?session=&agent=`) on pre-tool events like Claude/Codex, so OpenCode can halt canceled workers before any tool call. Implement this inside the OpenCode plugin before the write gate, using the session's registered `agent_id` when available and failing open when the daemon is unavailable.
